title: Simple Future
intro:
Simple future: will + kata kerja dasar, sama untuk semua subjek. Bentuk negatifnya won't (= will not) + kata kerja dasar. Will tidak pernah mendapat -s.
She will call you tomorrow.
They won't be late.

exercises.question: Tomorrow she ___ call you.
exercises.explanation: Future: will + kata kerja dasar. Will tidak pernah berubah, bahkan dengan she.

exercises.question: Pick the correct future sentence.
options: She will visit Bali next year.
She will visits Bali next year.
She wills visit Bali next year.
exercises.answer: She will visit Bali next year.
exercises.explanation: Setelah will, kata kerja selalu bentuk dasar: will visit.

exercises.question: I ___ forget your birthday, I promise!
exercises.explanation: Negatif future: won't = will not. Bentuk willn't tidak ada.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence using the words in brackets
exercises.explanation: Negatif future: won't (= will not) + kata kerja dasar: won't be.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the simple future
exercises.explanation: Will + kata kerja dasar: will arrive.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Subjek + will + kata kerja dasar + objek + waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each sentence to its future form
exercises.explanation: Dengan will, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: She eats jadi She will eat, He has jadi He will have.
Future: will + kata kerja dasar: will study.

exercises.modelAnswer: Tomorrow I will visit my grandmother.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan will + kata kerja dasar, misalnya 'Tomorrow I will visit my grandmother.'
